sections.title: Before booking in Greenville
sections.html:
Confirm whether you will meet in the studio or arrange a mobile visit, how much time is reserved and what palette format you receive. If you need help for an event, ask when the reference materials arrive and whether there is time to practise the look. Keep travel charges, physical swatches and makeup purchases visible in the budget.

  • What is the current total for the exact session I am booking?
  • When will I receive my palette and any follow-up materials?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: You can use Stylist AI to explore a few color ideas while waiting for a quote. Choose two possible outfit combinations and save the questions that remain unclear. A focused list makes a later consultation more useful: which neutral, which lip family, or how much contrast? Avoid replacing the wardrobe before you have tried the suggestions with familiar pieces.
